question: Can Yggdrasil select the smallest causally sufficient class using ONLY witnessed action-consequence data and compile it into existing persistent native numeric representations, without a hidden family label? Does the source-only calibration veto out-of-class quartic interventions?
hypothesis: On disjoint affine, quadratic, and cubic Boolean causal worlds, minimum-consistent native degree selection {1,2,3}, tested on source witnesses and gated by six source-only calibration interventions, will select true degree and achieve Brier 0.0 with complete 16-input held coverage, while matching the source-equivalent independent conventional minimum-degree GF2 and the stronger full degree3 GF2 baseline. Degree1/2 native checkpoints should be >=10% smaller than forced degree3. Out-of-class quartic perturbations should be rejected in >=2/3 independent slots per pilot without confident wrong approved held predictions.
reason: CKAD33R showed native degree2 numeric compilation is feasible only when given a supplied correct class. CKAD34 deliberately removes that per-world oracle. All class-selection mathematics remains conventional, so no scientific superiority or general intelligence claim is allowed.
model_family: Binary causal consequences from six numeric features (five observed context bits and one action bit), never text tokens. In 3 source families for each seed, three independent slots per family: intercept XOR linear subset mask, plus exactly two distinct quadratic monomials, plus exactly two distinct cubic monomials. OOD family: three additional slots with cubic base plus one randomly chosen quartic monomial; candidate is NEVER told family/degree/term identities.
source_design: Enumerate all 64 public context-action inputs and deterministically choose 42 linearly independent inputs under a degree3 GF2 feature-row matrix using only public inputs (no outcome). Choose next six remaining inputs by independent SHA order for witnessed calibration. Remaining 16 inputs are held and never source-fed. The same ordered input IDs are used across all 12 target slots, all controls, all seeds' respective common arms; true source outputs only revealed at actual 42+6 selected inputs. All 42 fit outcomes are provided to every model; six calibration outcomes only to algorithms whose protocol explicitly uses them (and to 48-row conventional/native controls); the 16 held outcomes are evaluator-only.
native_mechanism: Fit a fresh existing NativeContextBasis / NativeContextAccumulator for each target slot using degree1, then degree2, then degree3, selecting the lowest exactly consistent class on all 42 witnessed inputs; source-only six witnessed calibration inputs admit or veto a slot; program selected numeric coefficients and input-only support into the existing native 16-slot accumulator checkpoint. No alternative cognitive architecture or new shared owner memory. All old slots then undergo four independent new 42-witness pressure-slot updates; byte-identical cold restore; pre/post all 64 old-input readout equality, exact support ledger and fail-closed conflicting source append.
controls: Independent conventional source-only minimum-degree GF2 solver using distinct elimination code and exactly same 42 witnesses plus same six calibration outcomes
Fixed complete degree3 GF2 conventional oracle-class baseline trained on same 42 source witnesses and six source-only calibrators; no hidden family labels, stronger capacity upper bound
Original NativeCumulativeLearner.observe on all 48 public source witnesses, same 12 target slots, with existing provisional degree hypothesis and no forced quadratic assumption
Conventional polynomial logistic fitted on 48 source witnesses, input-only feature design; smoothed frequency and 0.5 sham
Out-of-class quartic negatives, plus ungated native min-degree ablation under same 42 witnessed fit outcomes
Cold native checkpoint exact parity, no outcome-table stored in profile, source-ledger 42/slot, constrained Class<=3, no held leakage, untouched siblings after contradictory attempt
budgets: Per pilot seed, 12 old slots x (42 fit+6 public calibration)=576 witnessed outcomes plus four separate 42-witness pressure slots=168; total 744 public outcomes. Held 16 x 3 graphs x 4 families=192 synthetic composition cases/seed. Exactly 2 fresh pilot seeds, no primary without separate authority. CPU-only hosted CI, no paid APIs or owner runners. Every arm has exactly same actions and observed outcomes where disclosed; detailed per-arm compute time and source cost separately reported.
score: Per family 48 held composition cases each arm, Brier and primitive coverage/committed-error counts; class confusion (true class ONLY evaluator labels), source-only cal-rejection, weight/support counts, checkpoint bytes per slot and total, fixed full degree3 parity, conventional MDL parity, 4 pressure slot interference, byte-exact cold restore, contradiction atomicity, wall/cpu cost. Abstain scored at 0.5 with no coverage exclusion.
pilot_go: Both seeds must have exact selected class 1/2/3 in all 9 in-family slots, compiled native Brier <=0.01 and >=95% committed primitive held coverage in each family, exact in-class Brier equality with conventional selected-degree AND fixed full degree3, >0.10 absolute Brier improvement over old unmodified native on at least one non-affine family per seed, mean combined checkpoint bytes for degree1/2 slots <=90% of the same slots forced degree3, OOD: reject >=2 of 3 quartic slots with zero confidently wrong OOD accepted primitive predictions and gated Brier<= ungated Brier; byte-cold/all64-retention/source/contradiction checks PASS. Otherwise SCREEN_NO_GO, never retune after score.
science_gate: SCIENTIFIC_PASS impossible from this pilot because conventional source-only MDL and forced degree3 are required controls of equivalent/stronger source/model class. Engineering feasibility ONLY; any claim of native causal-class discovery is restricted to selecting among a prespecified 3-class hypothesis portfolio, not unrestricted learning.
primary_policy: Reserved primary seeds 23741, 23742, 23743 untouched regardless of pilot engineering outcome. New unanticipated-family worlds and independent qualified owner/first-use approval would be required before scientific acceptance. No merge/promotion/deployment/Forge orchestration.
source_integrity: Prereg committed BEFORE source. Freeze campaign blob and control/qualifier code in Git source_lock before first-use. Publish original pilot JSON and SHA256, exact read-only negative checks and complete exact-SHA Linux/Windows regression on the post-evidence candidate. Never replay consumed first-use after failure, including infrastructure failures.

classification_rules.engineering_feasible: All frozen source/negative/memory and Brier/size criteria PASS on both pilots; SCIENTIFIC_PASS=false.
classification_rules.screen_no_go: Controls valid, but preset 2-seed gate missed; stop without primary.
classification_rules.invalid: Source/held leakage, unequal interventions, family label to model, changed seeds/code/thresholds, missing conventional baselines, pressure loss, cold drift or unqualified source provenance; infrastructure separately.
